messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Parenteral: 80 mg every 12 hours, administered by 15-minute infusion.

The study included 21 participants.

In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. A. 'includes': The subject treatment program or regimen incorporates the component or element specified by the object entity.
B. 'has participant': The subject study or trial includes the entity specified by the object as a participant or group.
C. 'is defined as': The subject condition or entity is defined by the description specified by the object entity.
